notes: WHITE: the seed clock is a white pappus sphere; the lavender shade, and the pappus rays keep form inside the white (no central dot: it read as an eye). BOBBING. Intro: the globe draws in a breath, then puffs: a volley of seeds launches off the blown flank at the foe and drifts away (the intro ends back at rest). Sport: pink dandelion. Taraxacum pseudoroseum, the pink dandelion of Central Asia: rose florets with pale tips (indexes 1-2 only).
